_comment: Shared vocabulary for every video. 'prompt_terms' seeds Whisper's initial prompt (it biases spelling AND anchors proper casing/punctuation for the whole transcript). 'corrections' are regex -> replacement, applied case-sensitively after transcription, to both segment text and word timestamps. A project can override/extend either by adding its own vocab.json in the project folder. The Acme Sync entries are placeholders — replace them with your product names; the rest are common tech terms Whisper garbles.
prompt_style: This is a product demo recorded by the Acme Sync team.
